quotes.chinese: 不做则已，要做就要做到最好。
quotes.english: Either do it or don't do it. If you do it, do it right.
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.chinese: 勇气是抗拒恐惧、掌控恐惧，而非没有恐惧。
quotes.english: Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear—not absence of fear.
quotes.author: 马克·吐温

quotes.chinese: 去做你害怕的事，恐惧必死。
quotes.english: Do the thing you fear, and the death of fear is certain.
quotes.author: 爱默生

quotes.chinese: 不行动滋生怀疑和恐惧。行动孕育信心和勇气。如果你想战胜恐惧，不要坐在家里空想，走出去，让自己忙碌起来。
quotes.english: Inaction breeds doubt and fear. Action breeds confidence and courage. If you want to conquer fear, do not sit home and think about it. Go out and get busy.
quotes.author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quotes.source_en: How to Win Friends and Influence People

quotes.chinese: 最困难的事情是决定行动，剩下的只是坚持而已。
quotes.english: The most difficult thing is the decision to act, the rest is merely tenacity.
quotes.author: 阿梅莉亚·埃尔哈特

quotes.chinese: 他们能，是因为他们认为自己能。
quotes.english: They can because they think they can.
quotes.author: 维吉尔

quotes.chinese: 勇敢的人不是没有恐惧的人，而是征服恐惧的人。
quotes.english: The brave man is not he who does not feel afraid, but he who conquers that fear.
quotes.author: 纳尔逊·曼德拉

quotes.chinese: 自由在于勇敢的行动。
quotes.english: Freedom lies in bold action.
quotes.author: 罗伯特·弗罗斯特

quotes.chinese: 以勇气行动，世界将为你打开无限可能。
quotes.english: Act with courage, and the world will open up to a multitude of possibilities.
quotes.author: 玛雅·安杰卢

quotes.chinese: 勇气不是没有恐惧，而是判断有比恐惧更重要的东西。
quotes.english: Courage is not the absence of fear, but rather the judgment that something else is more important than fear.
quotes.author: 安布罗斯·雷德蒙

quotes.chinese: 行动不一定带来快乐，但不行动一定没有快乐。
quotes.english: Action may not always bring happiness, but there is no happiness without action.
quotes.author: 本杰明·迪斯雷利

quotes.chinese: 勇气在于面对问题时的从容。
quotes.english: Courage consists in equality to the problem before us.
quotes.author: 爱默生

quotes.chinese: 恐惧制造危险，勇气驱散它。
quotes.english: Fear creates danger, and courage dispels it.
quotes.author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗

quotes.chinese: 勇气是最重要的人类品质，因为它保证了所有其他品质。
quotes.english: Courage is the first of human qualities because it guarantees all the others.
quotes.author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔

quotes.chinese: 勇气不是没有恐惧，而是在恐惧面前依然行动的能力。
quotes.english: Courage is not the absence of fear but the capacity for action despite our fears.
quotes.author: 约翰·麦凯恩

quotes.chinese: 除非你尝试做一些超出你已有能力的事情，否则你永远不会成长。
quotes.english: Unless you try to do something beyond what you have already mastered, you will never grow.
quotes.author: 爱默生

quotes.chinese: 世界需要行动，而不是空话。
quotes.english: The world is hungry for action, not words.
quotes.author: 纳尔逊·曼德拉

quotes.chinese: 胜利属于最坚韧不拔的人。
quotes.english: Victory belongs to the most persevering.
quotes.author: 拿破仑·波拿巴

quotes.chinese: 勇气不是没有恐惧，而是尽管恐惧仍然行动。
quotes.english: Courage is not the absence of fear, it is the acting in spite of it.
quotes.author: 马克·吐温

quotes.chinese: 果断行动，是战胜迷茫唯一的方式。
quotes.english: Decisive action is the only way to overcome confusion.
quotes.author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quotes.source_en: How to Stop Worrying and Start Living

quotes.chinese: 勇气是控制恐惧的能力，而不是没有恐惧。
quotes.english: Courage is the ability to control fear, not the absence of fear.
quotes.author: 约翰·肯尼迪

quotes.chinese: 我们获得力量、勇气和信心，是通过每一次真正停下来直面恐惧的经历。我们必须做我们认为做不到的事。
quotes.english: We gain strength, and courage, and confidence by each experience in which we really stop to look fear in the face. We must do that which we think we cannot.
quotes.author: 埃莉诺·罗斯福

quotes.chinese: 恐惧是纸老虎。你可以做任何你决定要做的事。
quotes.english: The fears are paper tigers. You can do anything you decide to do.
quotes.author: 阿梅莉亚·埃尔哈特

quotes.chinese: 真正的勇气是在道德危机中不保持中立。
quotes.english: True courage is not remaining neutral in times of moral crisis.
quotes.author: 但丁·阿利吉耶里

quotes.chinese: 想要有勇气，只要在需要勇气的时候勇敢地行动。
quotes.english: If you want to develop courage, then simply act courageously when it's called for.
quotes.author: 拿破仑·波拿巴

quotes.chinese: 勇者到处都有路可走。
quotes.english: The brave man finds a way everywhere.
quotes.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基

quotes.chinese: 只要行为正当，勇气会使你获得一切。
quotes.english: As long as the action is right, courage will get you everything.
quotes.author: 贝多芬

quotes.chinese: 成功者和失败者的区别，在于是否有勇气信赖自己的想法，敢于冒险和行动。
quotes.english: The difference between a success and a failure is often not ability or ideas, but the courage to trust one's own ideas and to take calculated risks and action.
quotes.author: 马克斯威尔·马尔兹

quotes.chinese: 不要因一次挫败就放弃你决心要达到的目的。
quotes.english: Do not, for one repulse, forgo the purpose that you resolved to effect.
quotes.author: 莎士比亚

quotes.chinese: 成功不是终点，失败也不是末日：唯有继续的勇气才是关键。
quotes.english: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
quotes.author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔

quotes.chinese: 生命中真正重要的是有伟大的目标，以及达到它的决心。
quotes.english: The important thing in life is to have a great aim, and the determination to attain it.
quotes.author: 歌德

quotes.chinese: 思想付诸行动是保持其活力和力量的唯一方式。
quotes.english: The only way to keep your thoughts alive and powerful is to act on them.
quotes.author: 威廉·詹姆斯

quotes.chinese: 一个行动胜过一打计划。
quotes.english: One action is worth a dozen plans.
quotes.author: 约翰·肯尼迪

quotes.chinese: 勇敢地面对你的恐惧，恐惧就会消失。
quotes.english: Face your fears bravely, and they will disappear.
quotes.author: 史蒂夫·乔布斯

quotes.chinese: 行动的勇气往往源于内心的坚定信念。
quotes.english: The courage to act often springs from inner conviction.
quotes.author: 马丁·路德·金

quotes.chinese: 勇敢不是没有恐惧，而是在恐惧面前依然前行。
quotes.english: Bravery is not the absence of fear, but moving forward in spite of it.
quotes.author: 罗莎·帕克斯

quotes.chinese: 等待感觉自己勇敢才去行动？抱歉。发展勇气的唯一方法就是勇敢地行动，直到你感觉勇敢。
quotes.english: Waiting to feel brave so that you can act brave? Sorry. The only way to develop courage is to act brave until you feel brave.
quotes.author: 玛莎·贝克

quotes.chinese: 勇气意味着即使害怕也要采取行动。
quotes.english: Courage means taking action even when you are afraid.
quotes.author: 布伦妮·布朗

quotes.chinese: 混乱的行动也比有序的不作为好。
quotes.english: Chaotic action is preferable to orderly inaction.
quotes.author: 威尔·罗杰斯

quotes.chinese: 行动有风险和代价。但它们远小于舒适的不作为所带来的长期风险。
quotes.english: There are risks and costs to action. But they are far less than the long-range risks of comfortable inaction.
quotes.author: 约翰·肯尼迪

quotes.chinese: 勇气是在战争中的行动就像在阻力中的运动。
quotes.english: Action in war is like movement in a resistant element.
quotes.author: 卡尔·冯·克劳塞维茨

quotes.chinese: 决心是在行动动机不足时限制怀疑痛苦和犹豫危险的力量。
quotes.english: The role of determination is to limit the agonies of doubt and the perils of hesitation when the motives for action are inadequate.
quotes.author: 卡尔·冯·克劳塞维茨

quotes.chinese: 智慧本身不是勇气，最聪明的人往往优柔寡断。
quotes.english: Intelligence alone is not courage; we often see that the most intelligent people are irresolute.
quotes.author: 卡尔·冯·克劳塞维茨

quotes.chinese: 善良是勇敢的，善良从来无所畏惧。
quotes.english: Virtue is brave, and goodness never fears.
quotes.author: 莎士比亚

quotes.chinese: 勇敢不等于鲁莽，但从不冒险则一事无成。
quotes.english: Courage is not recklessness, but nothing is ever achieved without taking risks.
quotes.author: 拿破仑·波拿巴

quotes.chinese: 一个成功者和一个失败者之间的区别，往往不在于能力大小或想法的好坏，而在于是否有勇气信赖自己的想法，在适当的程度上敢于冒险和行动。
quotes.english: The difference between a successful person and a failure is often not ability or the quality of ideas, but the courage to trust one's own ideas and to dare to take risks and act to the appropriate extent.
quotes.author: 马克斯威尔·马尔兹

quotes.chinese: 奋斗只是一种行动的昭示，而实际的行动却应该有详细的计划，清楚的段落，坚定的意志和力量。
quotes.english: Struggle is a demonstration of action, but actual action should have detailed plans, clear stages, firm will and strength.
quotes.author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quotes.source_en: How to Win Friends and Influence People

quotes.chinese: 一个人的胆子大，才能有作为；畏怯的人，懦弱的人，他虽然没有身临其境的危险，但只要一听到人家的恐吓言语，早已吓得不知所措，试问这样的人可能有什么建树呢？
quotes.english: Only those with courage can achieve; the timid and cowardly, even without facing real danger, are scared by mere threats—how can such people accomplish anything?
quotes.author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quotes.source_en: How to Stop Worrying and Start Living

quotes.chinese: 世上最重要的事，不在于我们在何处，而在于我们朝着什么方向走。
quotes.english: The most important thing in the world is not where we are, but in what direction we are moving.
quotes.author: 奥利弗·温德尔·霍姆斯

quotes.chinese: 有勇气做选择，世界就会为你打开无数可能。
quotes.english: Have the courage to make choices, and the world will open up countless possibilities.
quotes.author: 玛雅·安杰卢

quotes.chinese: 勇气是一次又一次地站起来，即使你不断跌倒。
quotes.english: Courage is getting up again and again, even when you keep falling.
quotes.author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔

quotes.chinese: 唯一的失败是不去尝试。
quotes.english: The only failure is not to try.
quotes.author: 乔治·克鲁尼

quotes.chinese: 敢于尝试，即使可能会失败，也比从未尝试过要好。
quotes.english: It is better to dare to try, even if you might fail, than never to have tried at all.
quotes.author: 阿尔弗雷德·丁尼生

quotes.chinese: 勇气不是鲁莽，但犹豫不决往往比错误的行动更有害。
quotes.english: Courage is not recklessness, but hesitation is often more harmful than wrong action.
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.chinese: 你不需要看到整个楼梯，只需要迈出第一步。
quotes.english: You don't have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.
quotes.author: 马丁·路德·金

quotes.chinese: 勇气是当恐惧来临时仍然继续前进。
quotes.english: Courage is continuing to move forward when fear comes.
quotes.author: 欧内斯特·海明威

quotes.chinese: 行动是治疗恐惧的唯一良药。
quotes.english: Action is the only remedy for fear.
quotes.author: 乔治·巴顿

quotes.chinese: 要成就大事，不仅要行动，还要梦想；不仅要计划，还要相信。
quotes.english: To achieve great things, we must not only act, but also dream; not only plan, but also believe.
quotes.author: 阿纳托尔·法朗士

quotes.chinese: 勇气在于站起来说话。
quotes.english: Courage consists in speaking up.
quotes.author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔

quotes.chinese: 人的一切行为都源于机会、本性、强迫、习惯、理性、激情和欲望。
quotes.english: All human actions have one or more of these seven causes: chance, nature, compulsions, habit, reason, passion, desire.
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.chinese: 我们采取的每一个行动，所做的每一件事，都是我们努力成为自己想要成为的人的过程中的胜利或失败。
quotes.english: Every action we take, everything we do, is either a victory or defeat in the struggle to become what we want to be.
quotes.author: 安妮·拜恩

quotes.chinese: 要成为真正的自己，唯一的办法就是勇敢地行动。
quotes.english: The only way to become your true self is to act courageously.
quotes.author: 奥斯卡·王尔德

quotes.chinese: 勇敢地生活，比苟且偷生要好得多。
quotes.english: It is much better to live bravely than to live in cowardice.
quotes.author: 亨利·詹姆斯

quotes.chinese: 没有行动的信念是死的。
quotes.english: Faith without action is dead.
quotes.author: 使徒雅各

quotes.chinese: 行动是对思想的最好诠释。
quotes.english: Action is the best interpretation of thought.
quotes.author: 约翰·洛克

quotes.chinese: 勇气是一种内在的决心，不顾障碍继续前进；怯懦是对环境的屈从。
quotes.english: Courage is an inner resolution to go forward despite obstacles; cowardice is submissive surrender to circumstances.
quotes.author: 马丁·路德·金

quotes.chinese: 一次勇敢的行动往往是非凡变革的转折点。
quotes.english: A single act of courage is often the tipping point for extraordinary change.
quotes.author: 安迪·斯坦利

quotes.chinese: 不要等待完美的时机。抓住当下，让它变得完美。
quotes.english: Don't wait for the perfect moment. Seize the moment and make it perfect.
quotes.author: 纪伯伦

quotes.chinese: 行动是恐惧的解药。
quotes.english: Action is the antidote to fear.
quotes.author: 彼得·德鲁克

quotes.chinese: 成功的人不是从不失败的人，而是从不放弃的人。
quotes.english: Successful people are not those who never fail, but those who never give up.
quotes.author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔

quotes.chinese: 真正的勇气体现在日常的行动中，而不仅仅是战场上的英勇。
quotes.english: True courage is shown in daily actions, not just in battlefield heroism.
quotes.author: 约翰·麦凯恩

quotes.chinese: 我们每个人都必须决定是勇敢地行动还是怯懦地退缩。
quotes.english: Each of us must decide whether to act courageously or to retreat in cowardice.
quotes.author: 约翰·肯尼迪

quotes.chinese: 人生最大的风险是不冒任何风险。
quotes.english: The biggest risk in life is not taking any risk.
quotes.author: 马克·扎克伯格

quotes.chinese: 活着不仅仅是为了存在，而是为了行动和成长。
quotes.english: Living is not just about existing, but about acting and growing.
quotes.author: 列夫·托尔斯泰

quotes.chinese: 勇气是当你害怕时仍然去做正确的事。
quotes.english: Courage is doing the right thing when you are afraid.
quotes.author: 哈里特·比彻·斯托

quotes.chinese: 有勇气的人不怕犯错，但他们从错误中学习。
quotes.english: Courageous people are not afraid to make mistakes, but they learn from them.
quotes.author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quotes.source_en: How to Win Friends and Influence People

quotes.chinese: 行动胜于言辞。
quotes.english: Actions speak louder than words.
quotes.author: 英语谚语

quotes.chinese: 勇气是灵魂在逆境中的行动。
quotes.english: Courage is the soul's action in adversity.
quotes.author: 托马斯·潘恩

quotes.chinese: 我们不能总是控制发生在自己身上的事，但可以控制自己的反应和行动。
quotes.english: We cannot always control what happens to us, but we can control our reactions and actions.
quotes.author: 维克多·弗兰克尔

quotes.chinese: 凡事都要勇于尝试，因为你永远不知道什么会成功。
quotes.english: Be brave enough to try everything, because you never know what will succeed.
quotes.author: 马克·吐温

quotes.chinese: 行动是通往成就的唯一桥梁。
quotes.english: Action is the only bridge to achievement.
quotes.author: 本杰明·富兰克林

quotes.chinese: 勇气始于行动，而不是等待。
quotes.english: Courage begins with action, not with waiting.
quotes.author: 玛雅·安杰卢

quotes.chinese: 恐惧常驻于心，但行动可以驱逐它。
quotes.english: Fear often resides in the heart, but action can drive it out.
quotes.author: 约翰·加尔文

quotes.chinese: 我们常常高估了风险，低估了自己的勇气。
quotes.english: We often overestimate the risks and underestimate our own courage.
quotes.author: 埃莉诺·罗斯福

quotes.chinese: 每一次勇敢的行动都让我们更接近更好的自己。
quotes.english: Every courageous action brings us closer to our better self.
quotes.author: 卡尔·荣格
quotes.source_en: The Collected Works of C.G. Jung

quotes.chinese: 行动起来，哪怕很小的一步，也比原地不动好。
quotes.english: Take action, even a small step, it's better than standing still.
quotes.author: 孔子

quotes.chinese: 勇气是把梦想变为现实的力量。
quotes.english: Courage is the power to turn dreams into reality.
quotes.author: 西蒙·波娃

quotes.chinese: 你害怕的事情，正是你成长需要去面对的事。
quotes.english: The thing you fear is exactly what you need to face to grow.
quotes.author: 卡洛斯·卡斯塔尼达

quotes.chinese: 想要征服恐惧，就要在恐惧面前保持行动。
quotes.english: To conquer fear, you must keep acting in the face of fear.
quotes.author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quotes.source_en: How to Stop Worrying and Start Living

quotes.chinese: 很多时候，最大的障碍不是外界的困难，而是内心的犹豫。
quotes.english: Often, the biggest obstacle is not external difficulty, but inner hesitation.
quotes.author: 拿破仑·希尔

quotes.chinese: 勇敢的人不是不恐惧，而是能战胜恐惧。
quotes.english: The brave man is not the one who does not fear, but the one who conquers fear.
quotes.author: 纳尔逊·曼德拉

quotes.chinese: 行动是沉默的，但结果会替你说话。
quotes.english: Action is silent, but the results will speak for you.
quotes.author: 罗纳德·里根

quotes.chinese: 最大的勇气是即使感到害怕也向前迈步。
quotes.english: The greatest courage is to step forward even when you feel afraid.
quotes.author: 亨利·福特

quotes.chinese: 行动是治疗懒惰和恐惧的最好方法。
quotes.english: Action is the best remedy for laziness and fear.
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.chinese: 要改变世界，首先要改变自己，而要改变自己，就要从行动开始。
quotes.english: To change the world, we must first change ourselves, and to change ourselves, we must start with action.
quotes.author: 甘地

quotes.chinese: 勇敢不仅仅是冒险，更是在正确的时间做正确的事。
quotes.english: Courage is not just about taking risks, but about doing the right thing at the right time.
quotes.author: 西塞罗

quotes.chinese: 改变始于决定，而成于行动。
quotes.english: Change begins with a decision and is completed by action.
quotes.author: 约翰·肯尼迪

quotes.chinese: 勇气是不退缩，即使你知道可能会失败。
quotes.english: Courage is not retreating, even when you know you might fail.
quotes.author: 海伦·凯勒

quotes.chinese: 人生最大的悲剧不是死亡，而是未曾真正活过。而活着的证明，就是行动。
quotes.english: The greatest tragedy in life is not death, but never truly living. And the proof of living is action.
quotes.author: 列夫·托尔斯泰

quotes.chinese: 带着勇气行动，你的恐惧就会在你面前消失。
quotes.english: Act with courage, and your fears will vanish before you.
